# Word lists

* `common-words.txt` - **default list, everyday English** (66,354 words). Generated by
  `scripts/build-common-words.py` from **SCOWL** 2020.12.07 (http://wordlist.aspell.net/,
  https://downloads.sourceforge.net/wordlist/scowl-2020.12.07.tar.gz), size 55, English + American + British word
  lists (inflections included); lowercase A-Z only (no proper nouns, abbreviations, apostrophes or hyphens);
  intersected with ENABLE; minus `common-exclude.txt` and `blocked-words.txt`; plus `common-add.txt`.
  SCOWL license: see `SCOWL-LICENSE.txt` (Copyright 2000-2018 Kevin Atkinson; free to use, copy, modify,
  distribute and sell provided the notice is kept).
* `common-exclude.txt` - two-letter words in SCOWL that aren't everyday English (MU NU ES EM TA HO).
* `common-add.txt` - everyday words SCOWL/ENABLE lack in lowercase form (OK).
* `blocked-words.txt` - slurs, never accepted in either list.
* `enable1.txt` - the **ENABLE** word list (Enhanced North American Benchmark LExicon, 172,823 words), **public
  domain**, from https://github.com/dolph/dictionary. Used only when a host turns on *Expert words*
  (plus `common-add.txt`; words of 2-15 letters).
